temporal_notes: Larvae collected from the field site in Akron around the time of the 2010 trial and reared to adulthood for baseline kdr frequency estimation.
source_text: Initial genotyping of 100 adult An. gambiae, which emerged from larvae collected at the field site (Akron), showed a kdr frequency of 0.91, a value consistent with the samples collected from the huts.

temporal_notes: Experimental hut trial ran for two complete rotations between June and September 2010.
source_text: The study was carried out in experimental huts situated in Akron, a village on the periphery of Porto Novo, the administrative capital of the Republic of Benin... The evaluation started one week after treatment and ran for two complete rotations between June and September 2010... Over the three-month trial, 865 An. gambiae sl... were caught in the huts.
